Peanut Butter & Date Smoothie

Cut back on the sugar-filled smoothies with this delicious smoothie which is a perfect combination of Peanut Butter and Dates.

3 minPreparation
2 minCooking
2Servings

Ingredients

For 2 servings

Let’s make it.

  1. Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend till smooth.
  2. Pour the mix into a tall glass, garnish with Almond/Roasted Coconut flakes.
